## Context
Cut the next minor release, 0.12.0, from reviewed main using docs/releasing.md. The current package and latest tag are 0.11.0/v0.11.0. PyPI is immutable; publication must use the dispatch-from-main workflow and its required pypi environment approval. The release date is 2026-08-15. Closed ticket reflective-sticky-grouper (9874-b1a9-2ff1-4cd3) is the 0.11.0 release precedent, not active duplicate work. CHANGELOG.md's [Unreleased] section already holds hand-curated entries, so per docs/releasing.md step 1a the changelog step is a retitle of [Unreleased] to [0.12.0] - 2026-08-15 (fresh empty [Unreleased] above it, compare links updated), not a make changelog regeneration.

## Plan
- Work in a fresh worktree based on current origin/main and confirm release prerequisites, identity, recent Gerrit history/rights, and channel state.
- Bump pyproject.toml and every version in server.json to 0.12.0; regenerate uv.lock so the root project version remains locked at 0.12.0; retitle CHANGELOG.md's curated [Unreleased] section to [0.12.0] - 2026-08-15 with a fresh empty [Unreleased] and correct compare links.
- Run version-lockstep and proportional release preflight: release-specific tests/guards, lock-currentness, lint, typecheck, full tests, build, and twine checks.
- Commit with DCO, Change-Id, and rebar-ticket trailer; send through Gerrit and wait for LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 with no unresolved comments, then Submit.
- After the bump lands on main, dispatch release.yml from main with version=0.12.0 and obtain the required pypi environment approval; monitor the entire workflow to a terminal result.
- Verify PyPI 0.12.0 plus PEP 740 provenance, the v0.12.0 GitHub tag/release and artifacts, MCP Registry 0.12.0, and the Homebrew tap bump (trigger autobump if useful).
- Install nava-rebar[mcp]==0.12.0 from PyPI in the distribution-channel environment and run the packaged post-publication probe.
- Record receipts and results on this ticket, then close it only after all acceptance criteria are met.

## File impact
- pyproject.toml — package version bump
- server.json — MCP manifest/package version bump
- uv.lock — root package version lockstep with pyproject.toml
- CHANGELOG.md — retitled curated 0.12.0 release section and compare links

## Rollback / failure policy
Before publish, stop on any failed guard, review, or CI vote and remediate through a new Gerrit patchset. After publish, PyPI cannot be replaced: if the artifact is bad, yank 0.12.0, de-list its GitHub Release, and cut a fixed patch version; do not overwrite artifacts or retag published content.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] pyproject.toml declares version 0.12.0.
- [x] server.json top-level version is 0.12.0.
- [x] Every server.json packages[].version is 0.12.0.
- [x] [operator-attested] uv.lock records the root nava-rebar package at version 0.12.0 and `uv lock --check` exits 0.
  provenance: environment=release-0.12.0 worktree venv (macOS, repo checkout); principal=RebarBotNava agent session; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — ran `uv lock` then `uv lock --check` (exit 0) and read version 0.12.0 from the nava-rebar package block.
- [x] CHANGELOG.md contains a hand-curated 0.12.0 section dated 2026-08-15.
- [x] CHANGELOG.md has a fresh Unreleased section and correct 0.12.0 compare links.
- [x] `python scripts/release_guards.py version-lockstep --version 0.12.0 --pyproject pyproject.toml --server-json server.json` exits 0.
- [x] [operator-attested] Release-specific guard and workflow tests exit 0.
  provenance: environment=release-0.12.0 worktree venv; principal=RebarBotNava agent session; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — pytest tests/unit/test_release_guards.py tests/unit/test_release_workflow_pins.py: 40 passed.
- [x] [operator-attested] `make lint` exits 0 under the worktree virtualenv.
  provenance: environment=release-0.12.0 worktree venv; principal=RebarBotNava agent session; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — make lint exit 0 (ruff+format+zizmor+actionlint+complexity ratchet).
- [x] [operator-attested] `make typecheck` exits 0 under the worktree virtualenv.
  provenance: environment=release-0.12.0 worktree venv; principal=RebarBotNava agent session; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — mypy: no issues in 551 files.
- [x] [operator-attested] `make test` exits 0 under the worktree virtualenv.
  provenance: environment=release-0.12.0 worktree venv with harness-injected GIT_CONFIG_* (safe.bareRepository=explicit) removed; principal=RebarBotNava agent session; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — 13525 passed, 0 failed; the injected-key failures were root-caused as environmental (see ticket comment).
- [x] [operator-attested] `python -m build` produces the 0.12.0 wheel and sdist.
  provenance: environment=release-0.12.0 worktree venv; principal=RebarBotNava agent session; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — built nava_rebar-0.12.0.tar.gz and nava_rebar-0.12.0-py3-none-any.whl.
- [x] [operator-attested] `python -m twine check dist/*` exits 0 for the built artifacts.
  provenance: environment=uvx twine (twine is CI-lock-pinned, not a dev-venv dep); principal=RebarBotNava agent session; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — both artifacts PASSED.
- [x] [operator-attested] The release commit contains DCO sign-off, a Gerrit Change-Id, and this rebar-ticket trailer.
  provenance: environment=release-0.12.0 worktree; principal=RebarBotNava agent session; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=static-analysis — git log -1 shows Signed-off-by, Change-Id I4603345ae8757533b48a2eecbde3c8f8dcd2d36a, rebar-ticket: 4dd2-4217-318a-4613 (commit 43ff5ec6fa, landed as b0aac2314b).
- [x] [operator-attested] Gerrit records LLM-Review +1 on the release change.
  provenance: environment=Gerrit REST /a/changes/1825/detail; principal=RebarBotNava (git credential helper); privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — LLM-Review +1 by rebar review bot.
- [x] [operator-attested] Gerrit records Verified +1 on the release change.
  provenance: environment=Gerrit REST /a/changes/1825/detail; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — Verified +1 by rebar CI bot.
- [x] [operator-attested] Gerrit has no unresolved comments on the release change.
  provenance: environment=Gerrit REST /a/changes/1825/detail; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — unresolved_comment_count=0.
- [x] [operator-attested] Gerrit submits the release change and the resulting commit is on main.
  provenance: environment=Gerrit REST POST /a/changes/1825/submit; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — status MERGED; origin/main shows b0aac2314b 'grassgreen-unfearful-quoll: release 0.12.0'.
- [x] [operator-attested] release.yml is dispatched from main with version input 0.12.0.
  provenance: environment=gh CLI; principal=JoeOakhartNava (configured gh credential); privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — run 31916566035 on refs/heads/main, headSha b0aac2314b, version input 0.12.0 (first dispatch 31916489765 failed closed in authorize racing mirror replication, as designed).
- [x] [operator-attested] The required pypi environment deployment is approved.
  provenance: environment=GitHub REST pending_deployments; principal=JoeOakhartNava (the environment's configured required reviewer); privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — POST approved env id 16423961866; publish proceeded.
- [x] [operator-attested] Every required release.yml job completes successfully.
  provenance: environment=gh run view 31916566035; principal=JoeOakhartNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — all 10 jobs conclusion=success.
- [x] PyPI serves nava-rebar 0.12.0.

  provenance: environment=GitHub REST repos/navapbc/rebar/releases/latest; principal=JoeOakhartNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — latest release tag_name=v0.12.0.
- [x] [operator-attested] GitHub Release v0.12.0 attaches the 0.12.0 wheel and sdist.
  provenance: environment=GitHub REST releases/latest; principal=JoeOakhartNava; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — assets: nava_rebar-0.12.0-py3-none-any.whl, nava_rebar-0.12.0.tar.gz, SHA256SUMS.
- [x] MCP Registry reports io.github.navapbc/rebar version 0.12.0.
- [x] [operator-attested] Homebrew tap Formula/rebar.rb points to the 0.12.0 PyPI sdist URL.
  provenance: environment=raw.githubusercontent.com navapbc/homebrew-rebar main Formula/rebar.rb after autobump run 31917337582 (success); principal=RebarBotNava agent session; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — url is files.pythonhosted.org/.../nava_rebar-0.12.0.tar.gz.
- [x] [operator-attested] Homebrew tap Formula/rebar.rb SHA-256 equals the PyPI 0.12.0 sdist digest.
  provenance: environment=formula vs pypi.org/pypi/nava-rebar/0.12.0/json; principal=RebarBotNava agent session; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — both 61a62efa4a58bbe64eebd144463d54c2ce40818ac402a8c914c66555852f17bd.
- [x] A fresh channel install of nava-rebar[mcp]==0.12.0 passes scripts/probe_rebar.py with zero failures.
- [x] Release receipts, any exceptions, and the rollback disposition are recorded on this ticket.
